record.name: Genes and gene programs in a shared CAD-in-T2D mechanism
record.question: dapper:KnowledgeGap.zNV20nhHamt-a4CeAktQQPoAivOJe6xk
record.context: A CAD-in-T2D evidence slice used to investigate the selected broader CAD gap. This authored design packet combines captured CFDE observations with explicitly illustrative KG membership assertions. No live agent ran.
record.closing_remarks: SHH, GLI3 and TCF7L2, together with the AMP AD / GTEx and PsychENCODE geneM16 programs, are implicated in the same CAD-in-T2D mechanism by their captured EAGGL loadings. Their PIGEAN trait-level results connect these assessments to CAD in people with type 2 diabetes. The illustrative membership assertions show how genes could be connected to the programs, but those links remain unverified. Together, the assessed relationships prioritize a mechanism for investigating the selected gap. They do not distinguish exposure-driven amplification of genetic risk from downstream readouts or reverse causation; that requires temporal or intervention evidence not present here.

record.statement: PIGEAN supports GLI3 trait-level involvement with a combined relevance score of 1.98; this is distinct from its mechanism loading.
PIGEAN supports TCF7L2 trait-level involvement with a combined relevance score of 2.42; this is distinct from its mechanism loading.
The EAGGL result supports TCF7L2 involvement in this mechanism through its reported loading of 0.3813 under cfde-inc-v2.
The EAGGL result supports involvement of the AMP AD / GTEx brain-aging set, with a loading of 1.0 on mechanism Factor1.
The EAGGL result supports involvement of the PsychENCODE geneM16 set, with a loading of 0.4518 on mechanism Factor1.
PIGEAN supports SHH trait-level involvement with a combined relevance score of 3.86; this is distinct from its mechanism loading.
PIGEAN supports trait-level involvement of the PsychENCODE geneM16 set, with beta=0.00729 and beta_uncorrected=0.0586.
The EAGGL result supports SHH involvement in this mechanism through its reported loading of 0.5042 under cfde-inc-v2.
The EAGGL result supports GLI3 involvement in this mechanism through its reported loading of 0.3245 under cfde-inc-v2.
For this illustrative scenario, a mock BiomarkerKG assertion supports TCF7L2 membership in the PsychENCODE geneM16 set. The membership is unverified.
For this illustrative scenario, a mock ProKN assertion supports SHH membership in the AMP AD / GTEx brain-aging set. The membership is unverified.
PIGEAN supports trait-level involvement of the AMP AD / GTEx brain-aging set, with beta=0.115 and beta_uncorrected=0.119.
SHH is involved in the biology of coronary artery disease in people with type 2 diabetes.
